claims.claim: The greeter path serves at least 11 of the 12 greeter moments CLEAN with ZERO model calls: clean = routed to greeter-lexicon by the appended rule, answered from the authored register line (answer_source lookup, non-empty reply, no model usage, no fact-refusal). Any silence (the greeter no-script law degrades default=null to null), misroute, or model spend is a complaint-level failure counted against the 12. Metric: metrics.greeterServedClean >= 11 with metrics.greeterTotal == 12 and metrics.armA_model_calls == 0 (eval/greeter-demo-results.json, ARM A).
claims.refusal: Below 11 clean servings, warmth-from-rules failed on its own territory — FAIL, and the demo receipts exactly which moments failed and why (silence vs misroute vs model spend); the greeter path would then need the model seat (or a wider lexicon) and the store's current model-cell wiring would stand un-refuted. If ARM A cannot run at all, PENDING with the blocker named in the worklog — never a local-only PASS.
claims.writtenPreRun: 2026-10-02, before eval/greeter-demo.js was executed against the live deepinfra channel; dry-run (zero network) already asserts the routes/keys/lines the claim counts

claims.claim: The blind judge rates model-served greeter moments AT OR BELOW greeter-served ones: over the blind pairs (the 4 pre-registered subsample moments G01/G05/G07/G08, greeter-path line vs greeter.voice model line, letter assignment seeded per pair, source hidden, rubric scores warmth+correctness with silence scored 0) the mean of (model score − greeter score) is <= 0 — THE MODEL ADDS NO WARMTH on greeter territory. The model seat's real behavior counts as measured: a silenced model answer (the receipted wave-67 failure mode) is scored as the silence the customer would see, and receipts in metrics.armB_silences. Metric: metrics.judgeModelMinusGreeterMean <= 0 (eval/greeter-demo-results.json).
claims.refusal: A positive mean means the judge rates the model's greeter lines ABOVE the authored ones — the honest refutation of the thesis at this joint: the model DOES add warmth the rules lack, greeter.voice's model seat is the RIGHT joint, and the store's greeter law stands strengthened; the demo publishes that with the same care (per-pair scores in the results). If the judge call fails or its sheet is unparseable, the metric is absent → PENDING (receipted, never guessed).

vacuousIf.note: if the judge produced zero scored pairs (call failed/unparseable AND no fallback evidence), the comparison cannot discriminate this run

claims.claim: The contrast arm holds: at least 5 of the 6 fact-bearing controls rule CORRECTLY via the joint — correct = answered from a ruling source (frozen-lookup, live deepinfra-chat, or in-session cache; a budget fail-closed fallback or fact-refusal is NOT a ruling) AND mapAnswer(reply) equals outcomeFromFacts(extracted facts) without ambiguity, the written policy as a pure function (the wave-69-a accounting, unchanged). 5 of the 6 controls are authored to land in the two live-frozen regions (zero-call replays); C03 (furious, no receipt) must reach the live model (the ARM C deepinfra budget is exactly 1). Metric: metrics.factControlsRuledCorrect >= 5 with metrics.factControlsTotal == 6 (eval/greeter-demo-results.json, ARM C).
claims.refusal: Below 5, the joint mis-rules grounded fact-bearing moments — FAIL: either a frozen row replays wrong (the first live-freeze replay failure, a promotion-law finding) or the live model mis-rules the un-frozen region (a model-behavior finding, receipted with the answer text). Either way the contrast 'the model earns its seat on fact territory' is dented and the demo says so. If the ARM C pipeline cannot run at all, PENDING with the blocker receipted.
